# kkp_service_account (Resource)

A project service account. Give it API tokens with `kkp_service_account_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kkp_service_account" "ci" {
  name  = "ci"
  group = "editors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Role in the project: `editors`, `viewers` or `projectmanagers`.
- `name` (String) Display name, unique within the project.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `creation_timestamp` (String)
- `id` (String) Service account ID, generated by KKP.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import kkp_service_account.ci <project_id>/<service_account_id>
```
